description: Attach or replace the photo on a recipe the user can edit: an image you generated (base64) or a public image URL (fetched from the web). Chef plan only, max 5 MB, PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF; replaces any old photo. Saved as a new revision. Blocked on read-only accounts. Returns {id, revision, image_saved, bytes}.

id.description: Recipe id (UUID) from search_recipes or an earlier result

image_base64.description: Base64 image data (a data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine)

image_url.description: Public https URL of the image; give this or image_base64

mime_type.description: Type of image_base64 if it has no data: prefix; default image/png

name: set_recipe_image
title: Add a recipe photo
